title: Dunedin carries frozen meat to Britain
summary: The sailing ship Dunedin left New Zealand on 15 February 1882 with thousands of frozen mutton and lamb carcasses and reached London 98 days later: the first full refrigerated meat cargo from New Zealand to England.
why: Showed meat could cross the world frozen, linking New Zealand farms to British tables.
superlativeSource: the first ship to successfully transport a full cargo of refrigerated meat
